page.overview:
Who is Avalanche?

Avalanche dies, along with almost all of Battle Force 2000, in RAH #113. Avalanche is mourned in the memorial issue, RAH #263.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Avalanche was individually carded as part of the Battle Force 2000 subset of G.I. Joe at the very end of 1987. In 1988 he was available carded in a special two-pack with Blaster and was discontinued the following year. ----

Appearance: white helmet and snow suit with brown camouflage; silver ammo belt on chest; silver shoulder guards, belt and boots
